double czz = (tile[lz + 1][ly][lx] + tile[lz - 1][ly][lx] -\n                        2.0 * tile[lz][ly][lx]) / (dz * dz);\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential\n__global__ void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ c, double* __restrict__ mu, const SimParams p) {\n    __shared__ double tile[TILE_Z + 2][TILE_Y + 2][TILE_X + 2];\n\n    const size_t nbx by < nby; by += gridDim.y) {\n            const size_t bx = blockIdx.x;\n            loadTile(tile, mu, p, bx * TILE_X, by * TILE_Y, bz * TILE_Z);\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const size_t x = bx * TILE_X + threadIdx.x;\n            const size_t y = by * TILE_Y + threadIdx.y;\n            const size_t z = bz * TILE_Z + threadIdx.z;\n            if (x < p.nx && y < p.ny && z < concentration field\n__global__ void initializeConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ c, const SimParams p) {\n    const size_t vol = p.nx * p.ny * p.nz;\n    const size_t stride = <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions\ndouble computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n    \n    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);\n    \n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                const double cv = c[idx];\n                \n                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) \n                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,\n                        const std::vector<double>& mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D * \n                           computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field\nvoid initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]\n                const size_t linear_id = z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));\n                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Check for NaN or Inf\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field\n    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded\n    double minVal = c[0];\n    double maxVal = c[0];\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds\n    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 64;\n    size_t ny = 0;\n    size_t nz = 0;\n    int iterations = 20;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Time steps: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Physical parameters\n    const double dx = 1.0;\n    const double dy = 1.0;\n    const double dz = 1.0;\n    const double dt = 0.01;\n    const double e_AA = -(2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double e_BB = -(2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double e_AB = (2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double gamma = 0.5;\n    const double D = 1.0;\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate arrays\n    std::vector<double> cold(gridSize);\n    std::vector<double> cnew(gridSize);\n    std::vector<double> mu(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize concentration field\n    printf(\"Initializing concentration field...\\n\");\n    initializeConcentration(cold, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    printf(\"Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int t = 0; t < iterations; ++t) {\n        // Compute chemical potential\n        computeChemicalPotential(cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, \n                                gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n        \n        // Update concentration\n        cahnHilliardUpdate(cnew, cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(cold, cnew);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance\n    double cellUpdates = external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(cold, \"Concentration\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfyuw96Ka4UJmEGkATwpN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The CUDA version is in place and produces bit-identical output to the original CPU program. The source is still `cahn_hilliard.cpp` and the executable is still `cahn_hilliard`; no new files were added to the project.\n\n**Verification**\n- Compared against the original CPU build, rebuilt with `-ffp-contract=off` for an apples-to-apples reference. Hashes, sums, min/max and samples match exactly on five shapes: 64³, 1×1×1-style 1-cell, 3×5×7, 33×9×5, 100×37×51 and 7×130×3, with 5–50 steps.\n- Throughput with validation off: 256³ × 100 steps is about 3000 MCellUpdates/s on the RTX 3090, against 169 for the original CPU build (~18×). 512³ × 50 steps is about 3060 against 131 (~23×).\n- The build is warning-free under `-Wall -Wextra`. The validation path passes on the default 64³ run.\n- I could not run compute-sanitizer: its injection library is missing in this environment. The non-tile-multiple grids matching bit-for-bit is the only indexing check I have.\n\n**Design**\n- Field arrays `cold`, `cnew` and `mu` stay on the device for the whole run. Buffers are swapped by pointer, and the host is only touched once at the end, for `-r` or `-v`.\n- Each time step is two kernels. Each block stages an interior tile with a 1-cell halo into shared memory (block 32×4×4, clamped at the boundaries). The chemical potential kernel reads `c`, and the update kernel reads `mu`. Grid y and z are grid-strided, so large extents work.\n- Initialization runs as a kernel that produces the same values as the original host loop.\n- The arithmetic keeps the original expression order.\n\n**CMake changes**\n- `project(... LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)`, `cmake_minimum_required` raised to 3.24 for `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native`.\n- `cahn_hilliard.cpp` is marked `LANGUAGE CUDA`. CUDA is required unconditionally.\n- `-O3 -Wall -Wextra -march=native` are forwarded to the host compiler, and `m` is still linked.\n\n**Choice for you**\n- I added `--fmad=false`. With the default, nvcc contracts multiply-adds into FMA and the results differ from the CPU reference in the last few bits. Without it, output is bit-identical. The cost is about 7% throughput (~3060 vs ~3280 MCellUpdates/s at 512³). If you only need agreement to roundoff, remove that flag from `CMakeLists.txt` for the extra speed."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1090,"cache_read_input_tokens":51962,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1090},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d212d408-4f26-451f-9a28-8631b799790e","uuid":"2c2f0529-7649-4e5d-920e-83a7477130b7","timestamp":"2026-10-13T08:22:57.717Z","request_id":"req_011Cfyuw8emd1HkZgo3SqMtg"}
